profile.name: 数据维度选择控件
profile.description: 这不是可识别的实体实验仪器，而是一个实验数据可视化与流程图界面中的图形控件。它用于从数据集里选择维度、坐标轴或因变量，并可配合节点界面、快照视图和监视刷新间隔输入等组件，服务于实验数据浏览、绘图配置和交互式分析。
profile.description_en: This is not an identifiable physical lab instrument but a GUI component used in laboratory data visualization and flowchart interfaces. It is used to select dimensions, axes, or dependent variables from datasets, and can work with node widgets, snapshot views, and monitor interval inputs for experimental data browsing, plot configuration, and interactive analysis.

registry.name: Simple wrapper widget for forms
registry.description: Dimension Combo是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、加载、启动、绘图、设备连接。支持Signal, Slot, addNodeWidget等操作。
